couple_perspectives.custom_advice: As a Growth investor, balance your desire to accelerate retirement savings with the immediate family protection gap. Start by obtaining term life quotes to close the large shortfall and confirm any employer 401(k) match; then channel remaining free cash into retirement contributions. Use clear steps and numbers to keep decisions collaborative.

With a Moderate comfort level, prioritize shoring up the emergency reserve and household protection first, then build retirement contributions steadily. Confirm whether each employer offers a 401(k) match and preserve a monthly buffer from the $15,032 net cash flow so trade-offs feel controlled and predictable.

suggested_questions: Can we get term quotes that close most of the shortfall at affordable premiums?
